scenes.title: De hoyo a torre
scenes.visual: frame 0: the worker digging a pit in the beach; at 'torre' a flash of the finished tower with people on top and the flood below; back to the pit, label ¿QUÉ GOLPE AGUANTA?

scenes.title: ¿Y si construyes así?
scenes.visual: a tower standing on the sand without piles; the quake shakes everything, the sand turns to soup, the tower sinks and tilts

scenes.title: Paso 1: pilotes
scenes.visual: steel piles driven down through the cut to the rock; labels 20 M and ROCA

scenes.title: Paso 2: patas
scenes.visual: the pile cap and four separate legs rise; water flows between them, label EL AGUA PASA

scenes.title: Paso 3: plataforma
scenes.visual: the platform lands on top; the flood rises to 8 m and stays below it; label 11,5 M

scenes.title: Paso 4: el truco
scenes.visual: wide stairs zigzag up the side; people climb them; label 700 PERSONAS

scenes.title: Paso 5: techo
scenes.visual: railings and the roof go on; the people on top

scenes.title: ¿Qué golpe aguanta?
scenes.visual: the flood; a fishing boat rides the wave in and hits a leg; the tower holds, the people safe on top

scenes.title: ¿Subirías o correrías?
scenes.visual: the people on top waving; labels ¿SUBIRÍAS? ¿O CORRERÍAS? DÍMELO ABAJO

scenes.title: De hoyo a torre
scenes.visual: frame 0's composition again (the pit, the worker digging), so it loops
